key_idea: Use a = sign(s)*1 and b = s-a, patching the cases where b would be zero.
sketch: For s>0 output 1 and s-1 (2 and -1 if s=1); for s<0 output -1 and s+1 (-2 and 1 if s=-1); for s=0 output 1 and -1. Choosing a with the same sign as s keeps |b|<=998, so the three-digit bound holds at s=+-999. Multiple answers are accepted, so the token checker flags sample 4 (it prints -999 999); validated with my own checker over all s in [-999,999] (sum, nonzero, range), which is why samples_passed is true.
